desk: Weekly priorities — Monday kickoff to Friday wins
title: Twelve cards, one each
prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph on a pale oak meeting table: twelve completely blank white index cards laid out in a neat grid of three rows of four, a few of them marked only with a small round coloured dot sticker in green, amber or red, two black marker pens with their caps on, a ceramic cup of flat white coffee, a closed spiral notebook and a phone lying face-down, soft diffused morning daylight from one side, gentle shadows, calm minimal editorial style
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
